theorem map_coinBlock_flatten {α : Type} (k : ℕ) (F : List Bool → α) : ∀ cs : List (List Bool), (∀ c ∈ cs, c.length = k) → (List.range cs.length).map (fun i => F (coinBlock k i cs.flatten)) = cs.map F
theorem ofFn_block_eq_coinBlock {r k sl : ℕ} (w : Fin (r * k + sl) → Bool) (i : Fin r) : List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => w (Fin.castAdd sl (finProdFinEquiv (i, j)))) = coinBlock k i (List.ofFn w)
theorem ofFn_eq_map_range {α : Type*} {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → α) (g : ℕ → α) (h : ∀ i : Fin r, f i = g i) : List.ofFn f = (List.range r).map g
theorem ofFn_natAdd_eq_drop {k sl : ℕ} (w : Fin (k + sl) → Bool) : List.ofFn (fun j : Fin sl => w (Fin.natAdd k j)) = (List.ofFn w).drop k
